title: hardcoded-path-check telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the hardcoded-path-check guard. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "hardcoded-path-check". Evolves additive-only. Carries NO matched path — only category labels.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit).

file.description: Path of the write target, relative to the consuming repo root when resolvable.

violations.description: Path-category labels detected in the new content (e.g. "Linux user path detected", "Windows user path detected"), one per category. NEVER the matched machine-specific path. Empty array on a clean scan (status ok).
